title: Check answer
description: The answer of the command check, on standard output, once the adapter has shown that its rights at the vendor and its settings work: offers, the machines the adapter can make with its settings. The adapter made no machine for it. A provisioner sends the offers of the adapter's last successful check as the offers of its claims, https://qory.dev/contracts/provisioner/v1/claim.schema.json. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. A member this schema does not define is refused.

offers.description: The machines the adapter can make with its settings, in the order of its settings, 1 to 64 of them: for each, disk_gib is the largest disk the adapter gives that machine. Each is a machine_spec of the provisioner contract.
